base.name: PlotNua Art Space Register
base.id_note: An identifier, not a credential: useless without the token. Stored in the Worker as the secret AIRTABLE_BASE so that it persists across deploys.
base.plan: Team (monthly), workspace 'My First Workspace' (founder, 13 Oct 2026). Snapshot retention: up to 1 year; trash: 7 days.

token.name: plotnua-art-space-register-worker
token.why_read: the duplicate-address check (one equality filter, one field, at most one row)
never: pasting into chat or the repository

retention_is_manual: FOUNDER DECISION 13 Oct 2026 22:18 (R1 + Option A). Registrations are kept for at most 12 months and deleted sooner when no longer needed. Hosts.erase_after and the 'Erasure due' view only FLAG records; nothing in Airtable, the Worker or this schema deletes anything automatically, and no automation may be added to do so. Deletion is a human act in the weekly review: (1) delete the Hosts record; (2) delete its Consent proofs row and its Status log row, found by the identical timestamp the Worker writes to all three (Hosts.submitted_at = Consent proofs.given_at = Status log.at; the Status log row also carries record_ref = the Hosts record id); (3) add ONE anonymous row to 'Deletion log'. No email, email hash, name or record id survives a deletion. Airtable keeps deleted records in its trash for 7 days and in automatic base snapshots for the plan's snapshot period (Team plan, confirmed 13 Oct 2026: up to 1 year); PlotNua never restores deleted registration records.
dates: Every date field: Date (ISO), include time, 24-hour, one fixed time zone for all collaborators. Created with Europe/Dublin, which is accepted: the Worker always sends UTC instants with a trailing Z, Airtable stores every dateTime as a UTC instant and returns UTC through the API, so the time zone setting changes only what a person sees. Formula results (erase_after, remove_after) should display in ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD); they were created in US format (M/D/YYYY), which is a display-only change.

fields.name: email_key
fields.note: lower-case email, for the duplicate check

fields.name: human_review_by
fields.note: leave blank; introductions are not authorised

fields.name: erase_after
fields.note: FLAG ONLY: 12-month maximum (founder, 13 Oct 2026). The formula and its view flag records that are due; a person deletes them.

views.name: New this week
views.filter: submitted_at is within the past week

views.name: Notes to screen
views.purpose: strip any address, Eircode, phone number or valuables from notes

views.name: Erasure due
views.filter: erase_after is on or before today
views.purpose: flags records reaching 12 months; a person deletes them and their consent proof and status-log row

fields.name: record_ref
fields.note: the Hosts record id as text: deliberately NOT a linked record, so the log survives the record's deletion

tables.name: Consent proofs

fields.name: email_hash
fields.note: SHA-256 of the lower-case email, written at registration. Under Option A this row is DELETED with the Hosts record; no fingerprint is kept after deletion.

fields.name: withdrawn_at
fields.note: UNUSED under Option A (13 Oct 2026): the consent proof is deleted with the record, so nothing is left to date or flag. May be removed from the base.

fields.name: deletion_honoured_at
fields.note: UNUSED under Option A (13 Oct 2026): the consent proof is deleted with the record, so nothing is left to date or flag. May be removed from the base.

fields.name: remove_after
fields.note: UNUSED under Option A (13 Oct 2026): the consent proof is deleted with the record, so nothing is left to date or flag. May be removed from the base.

tables.note: Consent evidence while a person is registered. Deleted together with the Hosts record (Option A).

tables.name: Deletion log
tables.writer: human only; the Worker has no access route to it
tables.purpose: Anonymous administrative evidence that deletions are carried out (Option A, founder 13 Oct 2026). LIMITATION: it cannot prove that a particular individual's record was deleted.

fields.name: requested_on
fields.note: date the deletion was requested or became due

relationships: None, by design. Under Option A nothing about a person survives their deletion: the Consent proofs and Status log rows are deleted with the Hosts record, matched by timestamp. The Deletion log holds no link or identifier.
